risks.description: Government or jurisdictional policy changes (e.g., moratoria, taxes, transfer restrictions, eligibility rules) suspend crediting or restrict transfers, reducing or delaying issuance and delivery.
Inaccurate measurements, missing data, or tampering in monitoring lead to adverse verification findings and downscaled or rejected credits, delaying issuance.
Failure to secure/maintain project finance or offtaker/counterparty default disrupts build/operations or settlement, preventing generation or timely delivery of contracted credits.
EPC delays, logistics bottlenecks, or contractor underperformance push commissioning and monitoring milestones, shifting or missing issuance windows.
Missing or revoked permits, licenses, or compliance breaches halt activities or invalidate monitoring, blocking verification and issuance.
Incorrect baseline/additionality or adverse updates to approved methodologies reduce eligible volumes or require re-baselining, cutting units or stalling issuance.
Equipment or process underperformance versus design (e.g., capture/destruction efficiency) yields fewer abated/removed tonnes than forecast, lowering issuance.
Operational downtime, maintenance gaps, adoption shortfalls, or shortages of required inputs/feedstock reduce realized activity and monitoring completeness, decreasing or delaying issuances.
For sequestration projects, fires, pests, harvest, or soil/biomass loss reverse stored carbon, triggering buffer deductions or invalidation that cuts available issuance.
Extreme weather, natural disasters, or conflict physically damage assets or restrict site access, interrupting monitoring periods and postponing credit generation and delivery.
Disputed land/resource rights or lack of Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) lead to injunctions or community blockades, suspending activities and jeopardizing verification.
Project activities induce emissions outside the boundary (activity or market leakage), requiring deductions that reduce credited quantity at issuance.
Registry account issues, serial generation errors, or platform backlogs delay credit issuance or transfer, hindering timely delivery/settlement.
